name: games
description: Games: games with sound over Claude (Missile Command, Chickn, Blocks, Rocks, Dash), endless and harder as they go, your top score to beat. A one-time $8 per machine.

display.title: Where games play
display.description: claude-window plays them over the window Claude runs in (the desktop app, or your terminal); fullscreen over the whole screen under the pointer. Both need macOS and Swift from the Xcode Command Line Tools.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Games play sounds. In a game, M mutes it too.
